title: Civil Services (IAS / IPS / IFS)
summary: India's highest administrative service with direct policy power, district governance, and societal impact.
summary_hi: भारत की सर्वोच्च प्रशासनिक सेवा, जिसमें ज़िला प्रशासन, जन-कल्याणकारी नीतियां और विशाल सामाजिक प्रभाव शामिल है।
education_path: 10+2 (Any Stream) -> Graduation (BA/B.Sc/B.Com/B.Tech) -> UPSC Civil Services Examination

parent_view.cost_range: Low to Moderate (Govt college: ₹10k - ₹50k total; self-study or standard coaching ₹30k - ₹1L)
parent_view.safety_level: Highest (Z-category / official security for senior officers)
parent_view.roi_timeline: Lifelong prestige, pension benefits, government accommodation, and medical cover
parent_view.parent_tip: Graduation can be done in any low-cost college while preparing for UPSC. Minimum degree cost.

title: Software Engineer / AI Developer
summary: Build mobile apps, enterprise cloud platforms, and generative AI systems with rapid international salary growth.
summary_hi: वेबसाइट, मोबाइल ऐप्स और AI सिस्टम बनाएं। बेहतरीन सैलरी और वर्क-फ्रॉम-होम के अवसर।
education_path: 12th PCM -> B.Tech CSE / IT or BCA + MCA or Modern Full-Stack Bootcamps

parent_view.cost_range: Govt Engineering: ₹2L - ₹6L total; Private: ₹6L - ₹15L (High education loan approval rate)
parent_view.roi_timeline: Fastest recovery: 1-3 years after graduation; high starting packages
parent_view.parent_tip: Skills matter more than college degree. Students can learn coding free on YouTube and get high-paying remote jobs.

title: Medical Doctor (MBBS / AYUSH)
summary: Heal illnesses, perform surgeries, and safeguard community healthcare with immense social respect.
summary_hi: मरीजों का इलाज, समाज में सर्वोच्च आदर और संकट के समय जीवनदान देने वाला नोबेल पेशा।
education_path: 10+2 with PCB (minimum 50%) -> NEET UG -> MBBS -> NEET PG for MD/MS specialization

parent_view.cost_range: Govt Medical College: ₹50k - ₹2L total; Private: ₹50L - ₹1Cr (Target Govt seats via NEET)
parent_view.roi_timeline: Long-term investment: Steady earnings start after 5.5 years internship
parent_view.parent_tip: Target Government Medical Colleges via NEET where fees are subsidized by Govt up to 90%.

title: Chartered Accountant (CA)
summary: Audit national corporate books, lead tax planning, corporate finance, and insolvency advisory.
summary_hi: वित्तीय ऑडिटिंग, टैक्स प्लानिंग और कंपनियों के मुख्य वित्तीय सलाहकार (CFO) बनने का रास्ता।
salary_range: ₹7 LPA - ₹25+ LPA (Self practice has high scalability)
education_path: 12th (Any Stream, Commerce preferred) -> CA Foundation -> CA Intermediate -> 2-year Articleship -> CA Final
top_colleges: Directly certified by Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

parent_view.cost_range: Extremely Low compared to B.Tech/MBBS (ICAI total fees ₹75,000 across 4 years; stipend earned in articleship)
parent_view.roi_timeline: Superb ROI: Articleship gives monthly stipend of ₹5,000 - ₹15,000 during study
parent_view.parent_tip: Lowest college fee among top-tier professions. No mandatory expensive college needed; ICAI postal study works.

free_resources.title: ICAI Bos Knowledge Portal Free Study Material
Free CA Foundation Lectures on ICAI YouTube

title: Bank Probationary Officer (IBPS / SBI PO)
summary: Manage banking operations, loans, credit risk, and branch administration in public sector banks.
summary_hi: सरकारी बैंकों (SBI, PNB आदि) में ऑफिसर पद, लोन अप्रूवल, शाखा प्रबंधन और सुरक्षित सम्मानजनक करियर।
education_path: 10+2 -> Any 3-year Graduation (BA/B.Com/B.Sc) -> IBPS PO / SBI PO Entrance Exam

parent_view.cost_range: Low: Standard graduation fee ₹15,000 - ₹40,000 + Exam fees ₹850
parent_view.roi_timeline: Instant ROI upon passing exam at age 21-25; concessional home/vehicle loans for staff
parent_view.parent_tip: Bank PO offers fast promotions. In 10-15 years, a student can become Chief Manager or Assistant General Manager.

free_resources.title: Free Quantitative Aptitude Practice on Testbook/Adda247

title: Police Sub-Inspector & Defence (NDA/CDS/Agniveer)
title_hi: पुलिस सब-इंस्पेक्टर / रक्षा बल (NDA, CDS, अग्निवीर)
summary: Serve the nation with valor, enforce law and order, protect borders, and lead armed units.
summary_hi: देश की सुरक्षा, सीमाओं की रक्षा, वर्दी का गर्व और समाज में कानून-व्यवस्था कायम रखने का गौरवशाली पथ।
salary_range: ₹35,400 - ₹1,25,000 / month + Uniform, Medical, Canteen & Family Housing
education_path: After 10th/12th -> Agniveer/NDA (for 12th) OR Graduation -> State Police SI / CDS Exam

parent_view.cost_range: Almost Zero (NDA/IMA training is 100% funded by Govt with monthly stipend!)
parent_view.safety_level: Physical field duty; strong medical insurance and institutional support
parent_view.roi_timeline: Immediate earnings right from cadet training or joining age 19-21
parent_view.parent_tip: NDA training at Khadakwasla is fully free with stipend and free B.Sc/BA degree from JNU.

title: Diploma Engineer & ITI Skilled Specialist
summary: Hands-on technical careers in electrical, mechanical, civil, electronics, and railway loco maintenance.
summary_hi: 10वीं के तुरंत बाद 2-3 साल में हुनरमंद इंजीनियर बनें। रेलवे, बिजली विभाग और फैक्ट्रियों में भारी मांग।
duration: 1 to 3 years (ITI: 1-2 yrs; Polytechnic Diploma: 3 yrs or 2 yrs lateral)
education_path: 10th Pass -> State Polytechnic Entrance Exam (JEECUP, Delhi CET) or ITI Trade -> Junior Engineer in PSUs / Lateral Entry to B.Tech 2nd Year
top_colleges: Govt Polytechnic Institutes in every district

parent_view.cost_range: Lowest: Govt Polytechnic fees is only ₹8,000 - ₹12,000 per year with UP/State Scholarships covering 100%
parent_view.roi_timeline: Quickest earning: Student starts earning at age 18-19 to support parents
parent_view.parent_tip: Ideal for rural families seeking fast financial independence. After 3-yr diploma, can directly enter 2nd year B.Tech if desired.

title: Data Scientist & Business Intelligence Analyst
summary: Analyze consumer trends, build predictive machine learning models, and guide CEO decision making.
summary_hi: आंकड़ों और डेटा से भविष्य के ट्रेंड का अनुमान लगाना, कंपनियों के मुनाफे और रणनीति में मदद करना।
salary_range: ₹6 LPA - ₹40+ LPA (Global remote opportunities in USD)
duration: 3 to 4 years (BCA / B.Sc Stats / B.Tech / Online BS)
education_path: 12th (Maths required) -> B.Sc Data Science / Statistics / B.Tech / IIT Madras Online BS in Data Science

parent_view.cost_range: IIT Madras Online Degree: ₹1L - ₹2.5L total (Can be done from home village with internet!)
parent_view.safety_level: Work from home / high-tech corporate offices
parent_view.roi_timeline: 1-2 years; students get internships of ₹25,000/mo while studying
parent_view.parent_tip: IIT Madras offers an official BS in Data Science for 12th pass students with no JEE required; complete study from home.

free_resources.title: Kaggle Micro-courses in Python & Machine Learning
NPTEL Data Science for Engineers (IIT Madras)

title: Corporate Lawyer / Judicial Magistrate
summary: Argue constitutional rights in High Court/Supreme Court, advise corporations on contracts, or clear Judiciary exam.
summary_hi: अदालतों में न्याय की वकालत, कॉर्पोरेट लीगल एडवाइजर या राज्य न्यायिक सेवा परीक्षा देकर जज (Judge) बनना।
duration: 5 years (Integrated BA LLB) or 3 years (LLB after Graduation)
education_path: 10+2 (Any Stream) -> CLAT / AILET Entrance -> 5-Year Integrated BA LLB / BBA LLB -> Bar Council Enrollment -> PCS (J) for Judiciary

parent_view.cost_range: Govt Law Faculty (e.g. DU, State Univ): ₹15k - ₹40k total; NLUs: ₹2L - ₹3L/year (Eligible for National Education Loans)
parent_view.safety_level: Respected civil courtroom and chamber environment
parent_view.roi_timeline: Immediate steady growth; Judicial Magistrates receive lifetime government rank
parent_view.parent_tip: Judiciary (Judge) exam can be written immediately after passing LLB at age 23-24.

title: UI/UX & Product Designer
summary: Design delightful user experiences for mobile apps, fintech dashboards, brand logos, and visual digital products.
summary_hi: मोबाइल ऐप और वेबसाइट के खूबसूरत और आसान इंटरफेस डिज़ाइन करना। भारी रिमोट और फ्रीलांसिंग मांग।
future_demand: High (Every business needs an app & website)
education_path: 10+2 -> B.Des / Visual Communication OR Direct Self-learning Figma + UI Portfolio

parent_view.cost_range: Low: Free to learn on YouTube + Figma is free for students; Laptop required
parent_view.safety_level: Safe remote home work or tech studios
parent_view.roi_timeline: Fastest: Student can earn during first year of college via Upwork/Fiverr/Indian startups
parent_view.parent_tip: Degree name is secondary; companies hire 100% based on Figma portfolio. Ideal for creative minds.

free_resources.title: Google UX Design Professional Certificate (Financial Aid Available)

title: B.Sc Nursing & Healthcare Specialist
summary: Provide critical intensive patient care in top hospitals with massive worldwide migration opportunities (UK, Germany, Gulf).
summary_hi: हॉस्पिटल में मरीजों की देखभाल और आईसीयू मैनेजमेंट। विदेशों (जर्मनी, यूके, खाड़ी देश) में सबसे ज़्यादा मांग।
education_path: 12th PCB -> State Nursing Entrance / AIIMS Nursing Entrance -> B.Sc Nursing (4 yrs) -> Govt Hospital / Foreign Licensing (OET/NCLEX)

parent_view.cost_range: Govt Nursing College: ₹10k - ₹30k total fees; Private: ₹2L - ₹4L (High bank loan availability)
parent_view.safety_level: Hospital environment with regulated night shifts
parent_view.roi_timeline: Zero unemployment: Every single nursing graduate gets placed immediately upon graduation
parent_view.parent_tip: High demand in Germany and UK with free visa and ₹2.5 Lakh/month starting salary for Indian nurses.

title: Govt & School Teacher / Lecturer (CTET / B.Ed)
summary: Shape the minds of youth in Kendriya Vidyalaya, Navodaya, or state govt schools with excellent work-life balance.
summary_hi: केंद्रीय विद्यालय, नवोदय या राज्य स्कूलों में शिक्षक। सम्मान, छुट्टियों का सुख और बच्चों का भविष्य संवारना।
education_path: 10+2 -> D.El.Ed (for Primary) OR 10+2 -> Graduation -> B.Ed -> CTET / State TET Exam

parent_view.cost_range: Low: D.El.Ed / B.Ed in Govt DIET college costs under ₹20,000 total
parent_view.safety_level: Safe daylight school hours (8 AM - 2 PM), 60+ days paid vacations
parent_view.roi_timeline: Predictable, peaceful family lifestyle with government pension/NPS
parent_view.parent_tip: Best profession for rural girls and youth who want respectful local employment and free summer vacations.

free_resources.title: Free CTET Previous Papers & Mock Tests

title: Digital Marketer & Social Growth Specialist
summary: Run Google Ads, Instagram growth campaigns, SEO, and affiliate marketing for modern brands and online stores.
summary_hi: गूगल एड्स, यूट्यूब मार्केटिंग, सोशल मीडिया और ई-कॉमर्स सेल्स बढ़ाना। अपनी दुकान या क्लाइंट्स के लिए काम।
salary_range: ₹3.5 LPA - ₹18+ LPA + Performance incentives & affiliate earnings
future_demand: High (Every offline business is moving online)
education_path: 10+2 (Any Stream) -> Free Google/Meta Certifications -> Practical live campaigns -> Agency or Freelance
entrance_exams: No formal entrance; industry relies on Google Ads & Meta Certified Media Planner certs
top_colleges: Open to all degree backgrounds (BA, B.Com, BBA, B.Sc)

parent_view.cost_range: Zero tuition: Google and Meta offer free official certifications
parent_view.roi_timeline: Within 3-6 months; youth can earn through freelance social management for local businesses
parent_view.parent_tip: High practical value. Even a small village youth can run Facebook ads for local merchants and earn ₹15k - ₹30k/month.

free_resources.title: Google Digital Garage - Fundamentals of Digital Marketing
HubSpot Academy Inbound Marketing Free Course

title: Commercial Airline Pilot
summary: Command passenger airliners (Airbus/Boeing) across international routes with elite lifestyle and prestige.
summary_hi: यात्री विमान उड़ाना, आसमान की ऊंचाइयों में करियर और विश्व स्तर पर उच्च वेतन व प्रतिष्ठा।
future_demand: High (India is fastest growing aviation market)
education_path: 10+2 with Physics & Maths -> DGCA Class 1 & 2 Medical -> Flying School (200 hrs flying) -> Commercial Pilot License (CPL) -> Type Rating
top_colleges: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA Raebareli)

parent_view.cost_range: High: ₹35L - ₹50L for 200 hours flying training (Secured bank education loans available from SBI)
parent_view.roi_timeline: First Officer starting salary ₹1.8L - ₹2.5L/month pays off loan within 3-4 years
parent_view.parent_tip: Students from humble backgrounds can also join Indian Air Force via NDA after 12th for 100% free pilot training with Govt officer rank.

title: B.Sc Agriculture & Organic Agribusiness
summary: Modernize Indian farming with precision drip tech, seed biotechnology, drone spraying, and organic export supply chains.
summary_hi: खेती को आधुनिक तकनीक, ड्रोन, जैविक खाद और एग्री-स्टार्टअप से जोड़कर ग्रामीण समृद्धि लाना।
salary_range: ₹3.5 LPA - ₹15+ LPA (Govt Agriculture Officer: ₹55,000/mo; Agribusiness: High profit)
education_path: 12th PCB/PCM -> ICAR AIEEA / State Agriculture Entrance -> 4-yr B.Sc Agriculture -> NABARD / IFFCO / Bank AFO Officer

parent_view.cost_range: Low: State Agriculture Universities have nominal fee ₹15,000 - ₹30,000/yr with ICAR scholarships
parent_view.roi_timeline: Special bank quota: IBPS recruits 3,000+ Agriculture Field Officers in Govt Banks every year
parent_view.parent_tip: Direct eligibility for Govt Agriculture Inspector, IFFCO, NABARD and dedicated Bank AFO posts that general grads cannot apply for.

free_resources.title: Kisan Suvidha & Krishi Vigyan Kendra Modules

title: Micro-Enterprise & MSME Entrepreneur
summary: Launch localized manufacturing, food processing, digital service agencies, or retail outlets with PMEGP/Mudra loans.
summary_hi: खुद का बिज़नेस, मैन्युफैक्चरिंग या ऑनलाइन स्टोर शुरू करना। प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा और PMEGP सब्सिडी योजना का लाभ।
education_path: 10th/12th/Graduate -> EDP (Entrepreneurship Development Program) -> Mudra Loan / Stand-Up India -> Enterprise Launch
entrance_exams: No entrance; business plan evaluation by MSME / District Industries Centre (DIC)
top_colleges: Local RSETI Centers (Free training by Govt Banks)

parent_view.cost_range: Mudra Shishu loan provides up to ₹50,000 without collateral; Kishore loan up to ₹5 Lakhs with 35% Govt subsidy under PMEGP
parent_view.roi_timeline: Builds family generational wealth and provides employment to fellow villagers
parent_view.parent_tip: Govt RSETI institutes in every district provide 100% free food, stay, and vocational business training with direct bank linkages.

free_resources.title: PMEGP Portal for 35% Govt Subsidy on Projects
